Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly reframed the criterion to the first Looney Labs publication (1999) for Icehouse pieces instead of the earliest commercial release overall, and introduced 1999 without verifying it. This ignored earlier commercial manufacturing of Icehouse pieces (e.g., by Icehouse Games starting in 1989), which would make Icehouse pieces earlier than Kill Doctor Lucky (1996). This misinterpretation and unverified assumption would directly lead to the wrong ordering.
